extractionMethod: 7z x against the built installer into a scratch directory; confirmed exit code 0 and listed contents.

symbolRegressionCheck.conclusion: Every prior-phase Rust-side symbol/string count is exactly unchanged. Zero Rust regression, consistent with this phase touching no Rust files.

frontendTextSearch.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings against the extracted cip-desktop.exe, searching for this phase's new frontend text alongside a control string known to be present and unchanged by this phase.
frontendTextSearch.conclusion: Reproduces the Phase 6.1-6.5 finding a sixth time: Tauri embeds the built frontend bundle into cip-desktop.exe in a compressed form plain strings(1)/nm(1) cannot search - 0 matches for new text is not evidence of absence, since the known-present, unchanged control string also returns 0 matches. Correctness for this phase's frontend-only change instead rests on: a fresh Vite build producing a new asset bundle hash, the installer's SHA-256 changing from the Phase 6.5 baseline, and the full 257/257 frontend test pass already recorded in pilot-evidence/6.6/build/onboarding-evidence.json.

architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero new database schema changes - confirmed by this phase touching no Rust files.
The setup notice's one button calls the exact same setMode('diagnostics') the header's own toggle already uses - no new navigation mechanism to verify at the binary level.
The walkthrough's dismiss state lives entirely in localStorage and component state - no backend surface exists to verify.
